explication: Libation is a cross-platform desktop and CLI application for scanning and organizing an Audible library, then downloading and decrypting selected audiobooks into managed files. Its main user workflow runs from account access and library discovery through searchable library records to download/decryption and file storage; import, export, and Audiobookshelf upload are related capabilities. Search uses a Lucene index backed by library records. The README establishes the product capabilities; several subsystem connections below are documented or reflected by module responsibilities, but unsampled implementations are not verified in detail.
